journeys.requirement_journey: Establish a clinic and sign in
journeys.request_response: Registration: tenant name/slug, owner name/email, password. Login: tenant_slug/email/password. Auth response contains token/user/tenant; `/me` user/tenant; logout no content
journeys.availability_and_tasks: Declared and called. Session fencing, offline restore and truthful revocation pending **S01–S03, S06**

journeys.api_contract: Called `POST /auth/forgot-password`; reset helper has no caller
journeys.roles: Public recovery with agreed tenant/account rules
journeys.request_response: Current mobile sends tenant_slug/email; usable email/link/token/reset result is not implemented as an API contract
journeys.availability_and_tasks: **Gap BD-01; R05**. Fortify web recovery exists, but mobile needs a working supported handoff or agreed API

journeys.request_response: Member list uses membership IDs, user and role; invite email/role → InvitationData; accept token/account fields → auth envelope
journeys.availability_and_tasks: Team list/create/disable called. Accept/revoke handoff incomplete; expired/disabled recovery and ownership guards **BD-07, BD-18; R02, R05**

journeys.requirement_journey: Provision site, rooms and storage before first stock
journeys.request_response: Cursor/limit → page<SiteData>. Required location lookup must include unused locations and site context
journeys.availability_and_tasks: Site list declared. Mobile site-detail helper is unused and unsupported. Location lookup absent **BD-02; R03**; no requirement to move web setup into mobile

journeys.api_contract: `GET/POST /products`, `PATCH/DELETE /products/{product}`, `GET /product-categories`; backend also declares product detail GET
journeys.request_response: Product request DTO: catalog fields/category/default location/threshold; → ProductData or page<ProductData>. Category list → list<ProductCategoryData>
journeys.availability_and_tasks: Declared. Complete pagination, selection, nullable updates, detail read and archive safety pending **R04, I05; BD-10, BD-17**

journeys.request_response: name/email/phone/address; product association product_id/supplier_reference/pack_size/price → SupplierData/SupplierProductData; supplier list paginated
journeys.availability_and_tasks: Declared. Supplier detail GET exists but is unused; historical references and full lookup results pending **R04, I04–I05; BD-10, BD-17**

journeys.api_contract: Current `/members` is an administration roster, not a clinical picker
journeys.request_response: Proposed fields: user_id/display name/eligibility, tenant-scoped; no broader roster or account data needed
journeys.availability_and_tasks: **Gap BD-02, BD-06; R02–R03, P01**. Exact eligibility and self-assignment rule pending clinic decision

journeys.request_response: site_id/name/serial_number/kind/status and optional manufacturer/model/notes → DeviceData or page<DeviceData>
journeys.availability_and_tasks: Declared; active selection, cache type collision and archive history pending **S04, R04, C05; BD-09, BD-10**

journeys.request_response: Program name/target_temperature_celsius/plateau_minutes/is_active; maintenance kind/performed_at/next_due_at/technician/description → lists and corresponding DTOs
journeys.availability_and_tasks: Declared. Program ownership/active-state and agreed maintenance release rules pending **C05; BD-09**

journeys.request_response: device_id, optional device_program_id/notes → CycleData; item description/optional batch_id → CycleItemData
journeys.availability_and_tasks: Declared. **No item PATCH**. Delete/recreate editing can lose evidence; require atomic edit or explicit restricted flow **C01, C05; BD-03, BD-09**

journeys.request_response: Control type/result/performed_at/notes → ControlTestData. Multipart file → CycleAttachmentData; list → list<DTO>
journeys.availability_and_tasks: Declared. Native Dio and browser multipart both called; base64 variant exists but is unused. Web controller defect, view permissions and actual upload/runtime need validation **C02, C05; BD-15**

journeys.roles: STOCK transitions; RELEASE decision; ALL read
journeys.request_response: Transition no body → CycleData; decision + optional reason → CycleReleaseData (actor/time/reason/decision)
journeys.availability_and_tasks: Writes called; release GET **unwired**. Guard prerequisites await clinic rules; concurrent state checks need correction **C02, C05; BD-09**

journeys.roles: ALL permitted reads; STOCK API management; OWNER web evidence settings
journeys.request_response: DLU packaging_type/storage_condition/shelf_life_days/reason → DluRuleData. Generation packaging_type/storage_condition → label collection
journeys.availability_and_tasks: Declared. DLU permission decision pending; concurrent generation/read failures and frozen settings acceptance pending **R01, C04–C05; BD-12**

journeys.api_contract: Declared `POST /labels/{label}/print`, `GET /labels/{label}/pdf`, `/qr-code`, `/datamatrix`; mobile has no print caller
journeys.roles: Label read/manage policy; web must separate view from print authorization
journeys.request_response: Print reason as required → LabelData; GET returns PDF/code bytes
journeys.availability_and_tasks: Web-owned scope. Reprint restores Used/Expired to Printed; real PDF ignores selected format version **C04; BD-05, BD-12**. Physical printer/scanner acceptance **D02**

journeys.requirement_journey: Scan or passively inspect a label
journeys.request_response: UUID/URN code → LabelScanResultData; blocked status throws 410 instead of returning selectable metadata
journeys.availability_and_tasks: Declared but **unsafe as passive lookup**: GET marks Printed→Used. Used by scanner/detail/NC subject resolution **C03, C06–C07; BD-04**

journeys.requirement_journey: Record patient usage and reopen its evidence
journeys.roles: CLINICAL write; ALL with usages.view read
journeys.request_response: patient_id/practitioner_id/procedure/optional used_at/notes → LabelUsageData. Existing GET returns one usage DTO or an error; mobile wraps it as history. Dossier → PDF
journeys.availability_and_tasks: Called usage routes; dossier unwired. Preserve event time, distinguish missing history from failed fetch, decide duplicate-use/offline behavior **O05, C03, C06–C07; BD-04, BD-06, BD-08**

journeys.request_response: Create has no patient-name body → generated PatientData reference; `filter[reference]`, limit → page<PatientData>
journeys.availability_and_tasks: Declared. Pseudonymous-reference scope preserved. Archived history must remain readable **P01, C07; BD-10**

journeys.request_response: subject_type/subject_id/description → NonConformityData; resolution → updated DTO
journeys.availability_and_tasks: Declared. Current mobile label-subject resolution invokes mutating/blocked GET. Complete subject search/recall handoff and resolution **C07; BD-04**

journeys.request_response: supplier_id + lines(product_id, qty_ordered, unit_price) → PurchaseOrderData; cancel optional reason; list page<PurchaseOrderData>
journeys.availability_and_tasks: Declared. Draft edit absent from API; decide supported edit contract; status Ordered does not prove supplier email delivery **I02, I04; BD-16**

journeys.request_response: location_id; lines[{purchase_order_line_id,batch_number,qty, optional expiry_date/discrepancy_reason}] → GoodsReceiptData
journeys.availability_and_tasks: Creation declared. Empty-clinic location choice blocked by stock-derived lookup; lot must be physical manufacturer lot. Receipt list/detail API absent **R03, I02, I04; BD-02, BD-16**

journeys.request_response: Required contract: receipt identity + file metadata/content → linked readable evidence; error/retry state separate from committed receipt
journeys.availability_and_tasks: **Gap BD-16; I03**. Upload failure after receipt commit must not recreate receipt

journeys.requirement_journey: See stock and select valid source/destination
journeys.api_contract: `GET /stock-levels`; mobile currently derives batch/location choices from it
journeys.request_response: limit/search/cursor contract → page<StockLevelData>, including batch/location/quantity
journeys.availability_and_tasks: Declared stock page; mobile takes first100 only. Independent complete batch/location lookup absent **R03, I01; BD-02, BD-17**

journeys.request_response: batch_id/location_id/qty/reason; transfer from_location_id/to_location_id → debit+credit DTOs; issue/adjust → StockMovementData
journeys.availability_and_tasks: Declared and called. Preserve original command/key and verify stock deltas/constraints under concurrency, expiry/recall and retries **O01–O06, I05; BD-08**

journeys.api_contract: No product/batch code resolution API or scanner mode declared in the current mobile flow
journeys.request_response: Required code normalization/lookup → tenant-owned product/batch, status and usable locations; manual fallback
journeys.availability_and_tasks: **Gap BD-02; I01**. Label scan endpoint cannot be repurposed as product lookup

journeys.requirement_journey: Quick create, edit, search and dashboard
journeys.request_response: Create patient_id/practitioner_id/impression_type/work_type/impression_date, optional laboratory/priority/notes/internal_comments → ProstheticCaseData. List filters patient_reference/practitioner_id/laboratory_id/work_type/status/from/to + cursor/limit
journeys.availability_and_tasks: Declared. Foreign practitioner validation, lookup completeness, filters and dated drafts pending **P01–P02, P05; BD-06, BD-17**

journeys.request_response: status/optional note → case; history list includes actor/from/to/note/time; waiting returns page<ProstheticCaseData> with aging
journeys.availability_and_tasks: Declared. `cancelled → impression_completed` already supported; placed terminal. Concurrent history and full waiting counts pending **P02, P06; BD-09, BD-17**

journeys.request_response: laboratory fields + active flag → LaboratoryData; list is array
journeys.availability_and_tasks: Declared. Preserve historical inactive selection and validate new selection **P01, R04**

journeys.request_response: deposit_requested/deposit_received/deposit_amount/final_payment_completed/remaining_balance/administrative_comments → case
journeys.availability_and_tasks: Declared. Mixed unauthorized fields produce403 before update. French money parsing and null semantics pending **P03, R01**. Payment warning before placement, not an invented hard block

journeys.request_response: Multipart file → ProstheticCaseAttachmentData; returned URL used for viewing; PDF summary generated on mobile
journeys.availability_and_tasks: Declared. Native/browser uploads have no backend idempotency middleware. Complete file inputs/viewing, expired URLs, multipage PDF **P04; BD-08, BD-15**

journeys.roles: ALL domain reads; audit OA; STOCK resolve
journeys.request_response: Open-state filter/cursor/limit → page<AlertData>; resolve → AlertData; mobile currently computes dashboard from capped lists
journeys.availability_and_tasks: Declared. Permission-aware accurate totals and visible errors pending **A01–A02; BD-14, BD-17**. Notification channel remains pending, not implemented by OS permission

journeys.request_response: Audit action/actor/subject/date filters; evidence patient_reference/cycle_number/batch_number/from/to/cursor; export matching filters → binary spreadsheet
journeys.availability_and_tasks: Read callers declared. Filtered export unwired; counts/date/filter/pagination semantics need acceptance **A03; BD-17**

journeys.requirement_journey: Request, download and reopen a complete archive
journeys.api_contract: `GET/POST /data-export-requests`, `POST /data-export-requests/{id}/download`; declared request detail GET; returned signed URL downloaded separately
journeys.request_response: Request → DataExportRequestData status/manifest; download → URL/expiry; URL → archive bytes
journeys.availability_and_tasks: Declared. Duplicate names overwrite files, failure/dispatch defects **A04; BD-11**; temporary file handling **D05**

journeys.api_contract: Generic replay sends stored method/path/body; no separate synchronization endpoint
journeys.request_response: Durable operation contract must retain key, exact payload encoding, actor/tenant/resource/schema/original event time; response/reconciliation identifies committed result
journeys.availability_and_tasks: Current outbox exists but safety incomplete **S01–S03, O01–O06; BD-08**. Offline reads/drafts and write eligibility need per-operation rules, not blanket replay

journeys.api_contract: No agreed external connector or credentialed integration contract established
journeys.request_response: Provider, direction, fields, fixture/sandbox and failure behavior pending
journeys.availability_and_tasks: **Decision D09; A06**. Existing analytics scaffolding is not a connector acceptance result

journeys.api_contract: Android/iOS distributions, signed media, workers/scheduler, backup/restore; no single API route
journeys.request_response: Named build/backend/device/printer evidence, recovery runbook and acceptance record
journeys.availability_and_tasks: Scope established; runtime proof pending **G02–G04, V01–V05, D01–D05, H01–H04; BD-13, BD-15, BD-19**

Durable records precede send; immutable owner/key/payload; unknown legacy owner remains quarantined; no uncertain resend after server retention without reconciliation; APIs remain authoritative for permission/state

limits: A route match does not prove payload compatibility or deployed behavior.
Controller request/DTO references describe source types, not a generated OpenAPI schema.
Dynamic retry/replay use original or stored operations; returned signed-file URLs are not fixed API declarations.
Paths in narrative matrix are relative to /v1; paths in this inventory include /v1.
